name: Altro
long_description:
Altro (altro.io) is a platform that enables members to build credit no matter who they are, where they are from, or their history of credit access/score. We serve the 68M people in the US (mainly Women and POC) who are denied credit due to historical bias and the lack of access that current banks provide to credit building and tools. (It wasn't until The Equal Credit Opportunity Act in the 1970's that Women and "Minorities" could even get fair access to credit)!


Altro has created a mobile that allows anyone to have access to credit, using their subscriptions as a means to start building their credit score. Altro lends to members a $75 Line of Credit to pay for their subscriptions, such as Netflix, Hulu, HelloFresh, etc. This card is built to solely work on the subscriptions that the member is already paying for, allowing them to securely use their $75 credit to build their credit using things they are already paying for.

Doing this empowers folx who were denied credit a way to start building their score and financial power. Altro will service millions of people in not only building their credit, but also gaining access to the tools (such as personal loans, emergency funds, car/house loans and more) that they could not access prior.
one_liner: Build Credit With Your Subscriptions

app_answers.question: Describe what your company does in 50 characters or less.
app_answers.answer: Help college students build credit fast & for free

app_answers.question: How long have each of you been working on this? How much of that has been full-time? Please explain.
app_answers.answer: I have experimented with the student financial crisis since my freshman year and started working with Ayush our Sophomore year (9 months working together). Aside from being full-time students, we have seen exponential growth in the company in the past 3 months and have gone full time on this venture since.

app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer:
Our company is developing a mobile app that allows users to build their credit score using non-traditional data points, such as rent, Netflix, utilities and other recurring payments. 

We do this by furnishing on-time payments from our users to the US Credit Bureaus. This data can be backlogged up to 2 years, allowing users to see a significant boost in their credit score in under 2 weeks. This is much faster than the 6-8 months it takes to build your credit using a credit card or loan.

Our product platform covers the following:

1. Jeeves Pay: Do you need to send capital calls between US & LATAM? Need cross-border payments that arrive as soon as the same day? 2. Jeeves Cards: Equip your team with globally-accepted physical cards for in-person purchases. Ship cards overseas for free or create virtual cards in seconds for secure, online purchases. Prepaid & credit options available depending on region.

3. Expense Management: Collect receipts through the mobile app, review expenses in real time, and streamline global reporting capabilities - all at no additional cost.

Benefits of the Jeeves Payments and Spend Management global platform include:

-- Free built-in expense management tools


-- No personal guarantees or contracts


-- Unlimited cards and users for free


-- No monthly fees or software fees


-- Competitive cross-border payment pricing


-- Spend and pay in your preferred currencies

Built for global companies. Loved by finance teams, including a large YC contingent. 
Join us today!

launches.title: Novel, Your International Business Bank Account ​​🌍 🌎
launches.tagline: The First Business Bank Account Made For International Founders 🏦 💳 💸
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We’re Aldrin and Paul, from [Novel](https://www.trynovel.com/)!

Novel is an international business bank account for global businesses. We provide international founders with a U.S. business bank account, 30+ multi-currency accounts, global payouts in 140+ currencies, and smart debit cards.

![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/ykzg-cdBJIwZ9TXgYARSV16B7poMw7Yd6L4qpQ9luVq1sO8CDaOqUiiT1vTaVq4iscwmdpp5YzGYso1zgE0uuB20sWWSRVAZ6xnoKVVLD5ZGnP0YxxgmkVIYcT7F05CFzz0-Ry1cejUevLIGzWvXvqhL-RCpkS7ChI6KM_mOdED30p4RBCneKDLu5A)

**The Problem ‼️**

**International businesses can’t access the U.S. financial services they need to grow.**

There has been an explosion of global founders choosing to form U.S. entities to make it easier to raise venture funding, use Stripe & PayPal, and sell to U.S. customers. 

Unfortunately, since non-U.S. residents don’t have an SSN, traditional financial institutions make it challenging for most global founders to open a real, high quality, FDIC-insured bank account. 

Even when it comes to emerging fintechs, international founders in particular have their own unique pain points: funding their business account from a local currency and bank, processing payouts in other currencies, and conducting business without getting their accounts frozen (many international founders using money transfer tools instead of bank accounts have had their accounts or funds frozen for months. Banks often do this as well). 

We had one early customer from Argentina come to us after their Wells Fargo account (with over $1M USD deposited) was shut down overnight with no notice!

**The Solution 👊🏿**

A bank tailored to international founders.

In as little as _30 minutes_ after filling out our 10 minute application online, we can open an account for a founder without an SSN. 

While many other banks are willing to look at applications from international founders, they still reject upwards of 30%+ of applicants 😥. Novel’s greater understanding of these customers allows us to better accommodate these founders. Our custom KYC process allows us to quickly identify the customer and their risk profile, and issue them an account. 

With Novel, founders all over the world can:

1. Quickly open a business checking account and fund via 30+ currencies
2. Receive physical and virtual debit cards
3. Conduct payouts in 140+ currencies (more than any existing bank)
4. Easily do domestic and global transfers at the lowest rates (0.35% above interbank - 2x cheaper than TransferWise)
5. Use their account to access services like Paypal, Stripe, and invoicing

 

**Think Novel could be a good fit for you or a friend? 💙**

We would love for you to try us out. Email us at [sales@trynovel.com](mailto:sales@trynovel.com) and we will provide you a free year of our Plus plan! If you need to move money globally to run your business, we’re here to help.

launches.title: doola MCP + API for US LLC Formation
launches.tagline: Start a business from inside Claude, Replit or your platform via our API.
launches.body:
Hey everyone,

Arjun here, CEO of doola (YC S20).

We just launched the doola MCP and wanted to share it with the YC community.

**What we built:** You can now start a Wyoming LLC inside Claude or Replit without leaving the platform. An AI agent collects the required information, passes it to our formation API, and hands the founder off to complete payment on doola.

**We are the first business formation and compliance platform to offer LLC formation via the Model Context Protocol standard**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100594&key=user_uploads/306058/50d183f0-47b7-4600-94b9-bd9e44f1deb3)

**Why we did this now:** A few months ago, I posted here when we opened our Formation API. We received 20+ inbound partnership messages from that post alone. The appetite for callable formation infrastructure is real and growing fast. MCP felt like the right next step.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100594&key=user_uploads/306058/004ae590-12e6-4034-a962-2134cf65b54a)

The API + MCP we have built can now empower businesses of all types and sizes to **offer whitelabeled US LLC formation and ongoing compliance at scale, fully powered by doola.** This now allows companies to use the tech we’ve built to:

* Streamline operations and outsource formations and filings to doola’s automation.


* Drive new revenue streams by offering a new product to your customer base (white-labeled or powered by doola).

We’re excited to continue empowering founders across the globe to turn their dream idea into their dream US businesses.

**Ask: If you're at a company considering embedding LLC formation or compliance infrastructure into your product, I'd love to talk. We’re actively onboarding new partners (more info below in PS on how to get in touch).**

We’ve helped 15,000+ founders across 175+ countries start U.S. LLCs. MCP is what the future of LLC formation looks like in an agentic world.

Happy to answer any questions here.

Lets doola it ⚡

PS: If you’d like to partner with us to offer formation in your platform via MCP or API, please email me at [arjun@doola.com](mailto:arjun@doola.com) or you can grab some time to chat and [learn more about accessing our MCP + Formation API here.](https://www.doola.com/business-solutions/company-formation-api/)

launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re thrilled to announce doola’s new fintech product for global entrepreneurs, which is now open to the YC community.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78385&key=user_uploads/306058/da2575af-7711-44ef-9f55-536803a6edab)

At doola, our mission is to empower global founders by helping them set up a US business without handling any complex paperwork.

In addition to business formation and tax compliance, doola’s new product will now allow global businesses and founders to deposit $USD and move money internationally from any continent, with no US Social Security Number required.

doola Money is a payment account that enables users to do a few things, including:

* depositing and storing US dollars
* making ACH and wire payments in the US
* send money internationally using FX or currency exchange transactions
* use your doola Money account for payouts from processors like Stripe or PayPal

Whether you’re a seasoned entrepreneur or a first-time business owner, doola Money opens doors to international transactions without the hassles of social security numbers or credit histories.

We’re excited to continue empowering founders across the globe to turn their dream idea into their dream US businesses.

YC companies can get early access to [doola Money](https://doola.com/money) today! 🚀

You can read and watch all about how to use doola Money here on [doola University](https://www.doola.com/university/a-guide-to-using-doola-money/).

launches.title: Decentro goes global | Multi-Currency Payment Collections
launches.tagline: Launching global payments & treasury from GIFT city for the world.
launches.body:
Hey YC community, we’re Rohit and team from **Decentro (YC S20)**, a full‑stack banking and payments API player from India.

Over the last few years, we’ve helped thousands of businesses plug into Indian banking, KYC, and payments infrastructure with simple APIs; now we’re extending that to global payments with our new **GIFT‑based PSP** and cross‑border collection stack.

## **The problem – global money in & out**

If you’re a trade finance player, marketplace, or fintech scaling globally, you probably live in some version of this mess:

* Multiple PSPs and bank partners across countries, each with different compliance, FX, and payout rules.
* Long, opaque onboarding cycles for cross‑border flows.
* Fragmented reporting across acquirers, currencies, and entities, making reconciliation and compliance audits painful.
* A fast‑moving regulatory environment (IFSCA, FEMA, local regimes) where a misstep can mean blocked flows or penalties.

This slows down companies that should be focusing on building products and acquiring customers, not chasing bank RM emails and interpreting circulars.

## **What we’re building – a compliant global PSP rail via GIFT**

We’ve become one of the first Indian payment aggregators to receive a final PSP license from IFSCA at GIFT City, and we’re wrapping that into a developer‑first global payments platform.

At a high level, here’s how it works:

* Single API / dashboard to collect global payments: Accept from international customers via cards, local methods, and bank transfers across multiple currencies, and settle into GIFT City or onshore INR.
* Built‑in compliance and reporting: We abstract GIFT City PSP rules, documentation, and transaction reporting so finance and compliance teams get ready‑to‑use exports and views.
* Faster settlement and better visibility: Unified ledgers and payout flows across corridors and partners, with clear T+ timelines, FX details, and status notifications.
* Modular APIs: Use us just as a cross‑border collection layer, or plug into the broader Decentro stack (KYC, domestic payouts, banking APIs) if you want a full‑stack infra partner.

## **Why we started working on this**

At Decentro, we began by solving for domestic Indian banking and payments APIs after running into fragmentation and long integrations at our previous companies.

As our customers scaled, the same questions kept coming up:

* “Can you help us collect from global customers and settle into our desired currency?”
* “Is there a compliant way to route this via GIFT City without adding three more partners?”

## **How it works – product flow**

Here’s a typical integration:

1. Configure your entity and use case (SaaS, marketplace, B2B payments, etc.) in our console, including purpose codes and underlying documentation.
2. Integrate our hosted checkout or APIs to start accepting payments in supported currencies and methods from your customers.
3. We route funds through our GIFT PSP stack, run compliance checks, and handle FX and settlements into your designated accounts.
4. Your finance and compliance teams use our dashboard and webhooks for reconciliation, returns, chargebacks, and regulatory reporting.

## Here’s a walkthrough video - <https://youtu.be/FYXg5-KSg-8>

If you’re:

* A SaaS or B2B company selling globally and settling into India.
* A marketplace, fintech, or infra company that needs compliant cross‑border rails via GIFT City.
* Or an existing YC company that wants to expand to Indian or India‑linked flows.

We’d love to chat.

* Website: <https://tinyurl.com/decentro-yc-launch>
* Global PSP product page: [**https://decentro.tech/global/gift-psp**](https://decentro.tech/global/gift-psp)
* YC founder: Rohit (Founder & CEO, Decentro – YC S20)

Comment here, or reach out and mention “Integrate YC PSP” so we can prioritize your onboarding and, if relevant, help you navigate the GIFT / IFSCA side as well.

Cheers!

name: Heron
long_description: Heron is on a mission to eliminate the underwriting tax on American businesses. When a consumer applies for credit, a spinning wheel can return an offer in seconds; when a business applies for a loan or insurance policy, humans still spend hours reading documents, verifying the business, detecting fraud, and deciding what to offer. Heron does that work in software: lenders, insurers, and credit brokers send applications in and get declines and offers out in minutes instead of days. We have underwritten roughly 1 in 8 US employer businesses in the past year. That scale allows us to go beyond what any individual could ever do: identify cross-customer signals across millions of businesses to build new data products, and ultimately become the data layer for private businesses in the US. launches.title: Avocado 🥑 Restaurant POS with a built-in AI agent
launches.tagline: Run your restaurant with an AI agent that updates your menu, prices, and more
launches.body:
## **🚀 We’re launching Avocado – Restaurant POS with a built-in AI agent**

👋 Hi YC! We’re Nick Evans and Shayan Guha, co-founders of **Avocado** - a point-of-sale system for restaurants that now includes a **fully integrated AI assistant**. We’re thrilled to share our biggest update yet.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/ce5f4736-b005-49ce-b579-8bf8596ce1e8)

---

## **🧠 The problem: running a restaurant is overwhelming**

Independent restaurant owners juggle dozens of tools, dozens of vendors, and constant interruptions - all while trying to serve food and keep customers happy. Managing the POS, updating menus, pulling sales reports, figuring out Instagram posts, dealing with changing prices… it’s a full-time job _on top of_ their actual full-time job.

But the real bottleneck? **Information is trapped in systems that don’t talk to each other**, and most POS systems are clunky, hard to use, or just dumb.

---

## **🍳 The solution: an AI agent that _knows_ your restaurant**

Avocado is a POS system designed from the ground up to work with an AI assistant. Our agent understands your menu, your modifiers, your sales data, your customers, your staff - and it can take action across the system in real time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/4f4d0889-0077-48bd-a427-72d160f30492)

You can ask it:

* “Add a matcha latte to the menu for $5.50”
* “What’s my best-selling item on weekends?”
* “Update all egg-based items to reflect the new cost of eggs”
* “Create a social media post featuring today’s specials”
* “Tell me which servers had the highest tips last week”

…and it just **does it**. Right away. No UI to navigate, no learning curve, no training required.

💡 This is more than a chatbot. This is a **restaurant-native AI agent** with full control over the POS, KDS, kiosk, and online ordering systems - like having a superpowered GM in your pocket.

---

# **Check out our launch video here**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O2QaQdDJlb0

---

# **✨ Here are some examples from the video:**

**Prompt** “Add a matcha latte to the menu”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/f4589fd7-69da-40c2-8d3f-a16fd766dbad)

**Prompt** “Write an Instagram post announcing our new matcha lattes”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/3e7c0988-ed76-486c-b3e0-e96ecb21629f)

**Prompt** “Raise all the prices of my egg dishes by 10%, round to the nearest quarter”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/0bfaae04-2776-442b-b3ba-3679ecedf2c7)

**Prompt** “We’re out of bacon. Mark everything with bacon as out of stock.”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/2f4ec1fd-7ff8-4720-bce0-753093934587)

\
**👩‍🍳 Why we built Avocado**

We’ve worked with restaurants for years and have seen the same story over and over: people want to focus on hospitality and food - not software. But they were stuck with outdated POS systems or janky integrations between too many tools.

So we built Avocado to be the _last_ system a restaurant needs - tightly integrated hardware + software, a beautiful POS UI, and now, a deeply capable AI agent.\
(Also, we were frustrated that nobody else had done it right. So we did.)

---

## **📣 Call to action**

We're looking to work with independent restaurants, food trucks, cafes, and anyone tired of using 5 different tools to run their shop. If you want to try Avocado or just want to chat about what we’re building:

📬 Email us: [founders@avocadopos.com](mailto:founders@avocadopos.com)\
📱 Text us: (512) 580-7988\
🌐 Website:[ https://avocadopos.com](https://avocadopos.com)

---

## **🙏 Asks**

* If you know restaurant owners - especially in Texas or California - please send them our way.
* We’d love feedback on the demo and ideas for what the AI agent should do next.

Thanks YC - can’t wait to hear what you think.\
**Nick & Shayan**

launches.title: 🔎 Procoto - Manage RFPs, contracts, and vendors with ease
launches.tagline: We simplify the source-to-contract process in a self-service tool built for everyone
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Juliet, Austin, Michael, and Michael. We’re the team behind [Procoto](https://procoto.com/). We’re on a mission to make procurement software more accessible and affordable for everyone.\
\
**tl;dr:** Procoto makes running RFPs, tracking contracts, and managing vendors simple and affordable. We get procurement teams out of dense systems and spreadsheets without having to drop a hefty check on SAP or Coupa.

And it’s self-service! No sales calls, redlines, or lengthy implementations. Snag our [YC launch offer](https://app.procoto.com/register?ref=yc) to get started!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71192&key=user_uploads/488165/ab363823-cd33-4b41-9d5e-05867dcf4d98)

### **😤 The problem with procurement software**

Small and mid-market companies face the same sourcing, contract, vendor, and spend management challenges of larger organizations, but with fewer resources and without the funds for an enterprise procurement platform.

* RFPs are conducted with spreadsheets and emails
* Time is wasted searching for, selecting, and inviting vendors to bid
* Contract terms, vendor information, and spend data are spread across systems
* Person hours are dedicated to data management rather than securing better rates
* Historical bidding and pricing disappear after the RFP
* The alternative solution today is a six-figure annual agreement with one of the big boys

### **😇 How we’re fixing it**

Procoto eschews (bless you) the complexity and the feature bloat of enterprise procurement software. We keep it simple and user-friendly in a tool built for everyone. Procoto automates the collection of RFP, contract, and vendor information into a centralized system and highlights savings opportunities based on historical data.

<https://youtu.be/1FCv2I6Ywho>

### 😍 **Community fav features**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71192&key=user_uploads/488165/d8592dd5-c2e2-4c7c-a311-5d8074c6eb9c)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71192&key=user_uploads/488165/9351376a-c992-482d-97d0-b34f049aed42)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71192&key=user_uploads/488165/39700cd7-521e-4664-ae5c-a319dd365891)

### **🤡 Why us?**

We built procurement organizations at a couple of startups and have used 30+ of our competitors’ software. We lived the pain we’re solving for years and finally left to build the solution we couldn’t find Something self-service, customizable, with UI/UX from this decade, and built for users without supply chain degrees.

### **🙏🏻 Our ask**

* Give Procoto a whirl if you run RFPs, sign contracts, or work with third-party vendors
* We’d love to talk to and learn from anyone in the procurement world, especially those in multi-site businesses:
  * Franchises
  * Hospitality
  * Restaurants
  * Apartment groups
  * PEs that manage any of the above

### **👀 The YC Deal**

* 30-day trial
* Complimentary vendor and contract data cleanup
* 40% off your first year if you go monthly ($59/mo)
* 50% off your first year if you go annual ($479/yr)
* [Redeem here](https://app.procoto.com/register?ref=yc)

If you’d like to learn more or have questions, shoot us an email at [michael@procoto.com](mailto:michael@procoto.com)!

launches.title: OWO: Send Money from WhatsApp Instantly
launches.tagline: Enabling 100M bank account owners in Nigeria send money on Whatsapp
launches.body:
https://owo.co

**TL;DR:** OWO, built by Mono, is an intelligent money interface on WhatsApp that lets Nigerians send money directly from their bank account to anyone nationwide — and soon, across Africa. Users can also buy airtime, data, and more — all securely, without leaving WhatsApp.

**Problem**

OWO solves a key problem: millions of Nigerians use WhatsApp daily, but can’t easily send money or pay bills from it. Traditional methods like USSD and banking apps are slow, unreliable, or hard to use.

**Solution**

With OWO, users can now send money, buy airtime, and more — directly inside WhatsApp, using simple text or voice. No new app, no stress. It’s fast, secure, and built on Mono’s licensed infrastructure.

For the first time, 100M+ Nigerian bank account holders can move money as easily as sending a message — and soon, across Africa.

https://youtu.be/f0UC5JDBRAU

**Ask**

We just crossed ₦1 billion ($700k) in processed transactions on OWO! 🚀

We’d really appreciate your support in sharing this milestone on social media and following us:

🐦 X: [@joinowo](https://x.com/@joinowo)

📸 Instagram: [@joinowo](https://instagram.com/joinowo)

Thanks for being part of the journey!

launches.title: DolarApp - the global account for people in LatAm
launches.tagline: Send, receive and pay in pesos, reais or dollars - all from one account
launches.body:
Hello all! We are [Zach](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zachgarman/), [Alvaro](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alvaro-correa/) and [Fernando](https://www.linkedin.com/in/fterres/) and we are proud to officially launch [DolarApp](https://www.dolarapp.com/) – the global account for Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, and Brazil. With DolarApp you can

* Dollarize your savings and earn 4% APY
* Get your own US bank account details (ACH and Routing Number) and get paid without hassle
* Spend internationally at the best rates, without hidden fees

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=66120&key=user_uploads/730279/e6f7d8b1-3fb0-4984-82a6-49584c992071)

\
**Why did we build DolarApp?**

The three of us have spent a lot of time in Latin America and made great friends there. Friends who, simply because of where they were born, see their financial freedom limited: hyperinflation, bans on saving in USD, nightmares trying to move money in/out of their country and crazy fees when paying with a card when traveling.

After spending a couple of years at Revolut, we learned that Fintech as we know it today is constrained by traditional financial systems, partners, and regulatory frameworks. We realized we could end those constraints by offering people in LatAm a better account for their everyday finances built on stablecoins, with focus on simplicity and away from typical crypto jargon and complexity.

**Key benefits of DolarApp**

With DolarApp, you will be able to:

* 🇺🇸 Get US bank account details without a Social Security Number
* 📥 Pay and get paid from local bank accounts, receiving / withdrawing USDc immediately
* 🌎 Spend internationally without hassle, at the best exchange rates
* 💲 Dollarize your savings
* 📈 Earn 4% on your balance annually, paid out second by second

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=66120&key=user_uploads/730279/65678393-8d08-4404-9375-bf98561c98ca)

**The ask**

* If you live in Mexico / Brazil / Colombia / Argentina, join DolarApp [here](https://dolarapp.onelink.me/SVAM/fnlwxe4b)
* If you have employees/family/friends in those countries who could benefit of having DolarApp, share this link with them!

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Forage addresses the complexity merchants and retailers face in accepting EBT payments online and in-store. This issue trickles down to the over 42 million Americans who rely on SNAP benefits for groceries. By providing a unified API, Forage simplifies the process for merchants, expanding access to groceries and ultimately feeding this underserved population.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Forage envisions a world where equal access to groceries is table stakes, regardless of one's socioeconomic status. By streamlining the acceptance of government assistance payments and helping SNAP shoppers save on groceries, Forage aims to empower merchants and consumers alike to foster a more inclusive economy.​

launches.title: Pideaky - Inventory-based lending
launches.tagline: We help offline LatAm SMBs manage and accelerate their cash flow.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We help offline LatAm SMBs manage and accelerate their cash flow through inventory-based financing and payments/collection/reconciliation solutions.

### 📜 The story

We have been working with LatAm SMBs for more than 20 years and previously built two great (non-startup) companies:

At payphone manufacturer ([R&C Telecomunicaciones](https://enlacee.org/rc-telecomunicaciones-2-2/)), we sold more than100k payphones to corner shops across Latin America (Chile, Perú Argentina, Central America, and México) as well as to major carriers such as Movistar, Bellsouth, Telcel, and Telmex.

I remember the day my daughter received a message from her boyfriend, bypassing me! At that time, we all mainly used landline phones to communicate. This is when I realized that young people started connecting through the Internet, and I started thinking about how I should use this trend—to provide Internet access to people using the corner shop network.

So, we built the internet network (ORCA Wireless) from scratch and provided service to 250k neighbors of corner shops.

### 🥅 What Pideaky is

At Pideaky, we help offline LatAm SMBs manage and accelerate their cash flow through inventory-based financing and payments/collection/reconciliation solutions.

In 2021, we started by providing point-of-sale solutions to corner shops in Mexico.

**Our Customers:**

Corner shops that sell groceries and lack financial records, as well as their suppliers.

**The Problem:** Over time, we discovered that access to capital was the biggest challenge for these corner shops.

**The Solution:** Inventory-based lending powered by our proprietary AI

**Market Size:** Businesses like these account for almost $70B/year in gross merchandise value.

**Tech stack:** We build and train an AI tool that Translates photos and videos into credit scores and risk models using AI and computer vision (with 90% accuracy today). We also developed the best-in-class automated collection and reconciliation tools to collect our loans.

**New Opportunity:** These tools are helping us to acquire Corner shop suppliers as customers; **we help them manage and collect their invoices in minutes, not days,** and they allow us to increase the network of Corner shops.

**Our Impact:** More than 14,000 loans were disbursed, and more than 6K corner shops served.

**Our Backers:**

We’re backed by Silicon Valley VCs (Wayfinder, Goodwater) and are actively hiring and expanding across Mexico/LatAm. Let us know if you'd like to connect—I’m open for coffee chats.

Check us out at [**Pideaky.com**](http://Pideaky.com) or chat with me by emailing [carlos@pideaky.com](mailto:carlos@pideaky.com)

launches.title: 💸 Formance: Open, modular foundation for unique payment flows
launches.tagline: Build, operate and track money movements of any size and shape on a solid and open-source system-of-record (ledger)
launches.body:
Hi everyone!

We’re developing an open-source solution to enable fintechs, marketplaces and platforms to build, operate and track money movements of any size and shape on a solid system-of-record (also known as a financial ledger)

**✌️ Check out our main Github repository here:** [**https://github.com/numary/ledger**](https://github.com/numary/ledger\*\*)

## **The problem**

Fintechs, marketplaces, and platforms growth is closely tied to their ability to:

1. Process an increasing volume of transactions, and
2. Implement competitive payment scenarios, which can become increasingly complex, e.g. complex commission models, improved time-to-money and creative payout schedules, embedded fractional ownership of various investment assets, omnibus accounts and the likes.

Engineering teams spend valuable time building themselves these money flows and the way they are broken down; then making them evolve according to the development and the strategy of the company. Additionally, tracking and reconciliating these flows from pay-ins to payouts quickly upgrades itself from an small annoyance to a _did-we-lost-10millions-type-of-problem™️_

Formance is tackling this particular segment in the payment value chain which is still painful for engineering teams, yet critical: the break-down and tracking of money between inflows and outflows.

## **The solution**

**✌️ Check out our main Github repository here:** [**https://github.com/formancehq/stack**](https://github.com/numary/ledger\*\*)

Formance solution is based on four products designed to **improve your economics, save time and limit costly errors:**

**1/ A simple and open-source programming language for money**: designed for engineering and payments teams, this low-code language enables the creation of reliable and unique payment scenarios in a few hours, rather than days, without any particular technical expertise related to payments;

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64456&key=user_uploads/144945/882aa901-0827-41c2-9dfc-4fecdbe29c8d)

**2/ Pre-built and extendable use-case templates**: these templates allow to quickly implement new business strategies or product features, check them out here: <https://www.formance.com/use-cases-library>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64456&key=user_uploads/144945/731eced2-67fb-4c65-8762-26d0214a61d3)

**3/ An open-source financial ledger**: working in tandem with our language and designed for reliability, this immutable system-of-record enables the track financial flows that move value through various merchants, intermediaries, parties and the extraction of data for business analysis and decision-making

**4/ Real-time transaction tracking tools**: designed for finance and operations teams, these tools enable the reconciliation of pay-ins and payouts, and the identification of issues related to transactions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64456&key=user_uploads/144945/037dee85-7949-4b3a-85bd-3156b0285bdf)

We believe that open-source and low-code go hand-in-hand with the diversity of money flows, payment scenarios and strategies that will make your company win.

**🤙 Ping us anytime, we’re always more than happy to help and have a chat!**

→ **Schedule a call here**: <https://calendly.com/numary/chat-with-numary?month=2022-07>

→ **Drop us an email**: [founders@formance.com](mailto:founders@formance.com)

→ **Check out use-cases library**: <https://www.formance.com/use-cases-library>

launches.title: Cumbuca: The first proxy for the Brazilian regulated ecosystem
launches.tagline: Develop your own payments infra in Brazil using our license.
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋

We're Daniel, Bruno, and Pedro — founders of Cumbuca. We’re the first proxy for Brazil’s regulated ecosystem. After years of building fintechs in Brazil, we saw how painful it is to obtain a license or depend on PSPs and BaaS providers. Our previous B2C operation scaled to over a million accounts, and we suffered since a lot of our core product relied on partner infra, and it hurt us to not be able to solve the issues affecting our customers. We’ve been deeply involved with Open Finance since its earliest days — we were one of the first players in the ecosystem and became the **fourth ITP/PISP license ever issued in Brazil**, and after closing our B2C operation decided to pivot to B2B and build the financial infrastructure partner we always wished existed for ourselves.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F4_E2LYNBCQ

## TL;DR

**Cumbuca is the first regulatory proxy for Brazil's Open Finance and Pix ecosystem.** We give fintechs the same development freedom they'd have with their own license — direct API access, full operational control, custom infrastructure — while we handle compliance. No more choosing between years of licensing delays or surrendering control to third-party providers.

**Ask:** Are you a global fintech looking to enter Brazil, or a payments company scaling beyond your current provider? Let's talk → [daniel@cumbuca.com](mailto:daniel@cumbuca.com)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95950&key=user_uploads/358823/0a8e01c7-dfb2-4489-aafa-c3e8f00a12bb)

## ❌ The Problem

Brazil is one of the most exciting fintech markets in the world — a forward-thinking Central Bank, Pix (the world's most successful instant payments system), and a mature Open Finance framework. Global fintechs want in.

But the path to market is brutal:

**Option 1: Get your own license**

* 12-24 months waiting for approval
* Millions in regulatory capital
* Constant compliance obligations
* Need local expertise to navigate BACEN's evolving regulations

**Option 2: Use a BaaS/OFaaS provider**

* Fast time-to-market, but...
* You're locked into their APIs and abstractions
* Their maintenance windows = your downtime
* Their support tickets = your customers waiting
* Their roadmap = your product limitations
* They use YOUR operational data for their own credit models

For companies serious about Brazil, neither option works. You either wait years or give up control of your destiny.

---

## 🛠 Our Solution: A Regulatory Proxy

We built something new: **a proxy that sits between your infrastructure and Brazil's regulated ecosystem.**

Here's how it works:

1. **You build your own infrastructure** using the exact same APIs that licensed institutions use
2. **You send requests to our proxy**, which signs and forwards them under our license
3. **You receive 1:1 responses** from the Central Bank ecosystem — no abstractions, no transformations

**The key insight:** Instead of building "Cumbuca APIs" (which would impose our abstractions), we built a minimal regulatory layer. You develop against the official Open Finance and Pix specifications. When you're ready for your own license, you just swap our certificates for yours.

**What you get:**

* ⚡ **Immediate access** — start building today, not in 2 years
* 🔧 **Full development freedom** — same API surface as licensed players
* 🏗️ **Own your infrastructure** — build it yourself or use partner modules
* 📊 **Own your data** — we don't use it for anything commercial
* 🛡️ **Resolve issues directly** — no middlemen when problems arise
* 🔄 **Future-proof** — migrate to your own license with minimal effort

---

## 👨‍💻 The Team

We didn't build Cumbuca from a whiteboard — we built it from scars.

**Daniel Ruhman (CEO)** — Started coding as a kid after watching "The Social Network." Dropped out of Computer Engineering to study at UC Berkeley. Built and pivoted through multiple startups: a gig economy platform, a Pix-native neobank for underserved Brazilians (Comadre), and a group expense app that grew to over 1 million accounts (Cumbuca B2C). Applied to YC 8 times before getting in.

**Bruno Cury & Pedro Castilho (Co-founders)** — Together with Daniel, they became among the youngest statutory directors in Brazil's financial sector when they secured their first license in 2022. They've lived every pain point of building on Brazilian financial infrastructure.

We've assembled a dream team of Open Finance veterans:

* **Gustavo Lino** (Head of Policy, Legal & Compliance) — Former President of INIT (Brazilian Association of Payment Initiators), board member of Open Finance Brazil
* **Nic Marcondes** (Director of Open Finance) — Architect of the no-redirect payment flow (JSR), the technology behind Pix by Proximity. 5+ years building Open Finance before it officially existed.
* **Ana Luisa Monteiro** (CFO) — Expert in Brazil's financial markets and regulated operations

---

## 🚀 Our Journey

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95950&key=user_uploads/358823/7e9d0ec2-b17f-4efb-908c-9dd724d88dd1)

This is actually our **third pivot** — and it's working.

We were one of the first 5 companies to apply for a pure PISP license in Brazil. We co-founded INIT, the Payment Initiators Association. We operated over 1 million consumer accounts and learned firsthand how painful it is to depend on infrastructure you don't control.

When our B2C monetization model failed (users only wanted Pix, not cards), we faced a choice: burn through our runway or leverage our real assets — our license and our team.

We chose to build the infrastructure partner we always wished existed.

**The result:** Cumbuca has been profitable and cash-flow positive since August 2025 — just 3 months after pivoting to B2B.

---

## 🎯 Who We Work With

Cumbuca is **not a self-serve platform**. We work with:

* **Global fintechs entering Brazil** — Series B+ companies that need more control than BaaS can offer
* **Companies outgrowing their BaaS/OFaaS** — Ready to verticalize but don't want to wait for a license
* **Companies in the licensing queue** — Start building and operating now, migrate when approved

Our customers include credit companies using Open Finance data for underwriting, payment orchestrators, e-commerce giants, PFM apps, and investment aggregators.

---

## 🙏 Our Ask

* **Entering Brazil?** Let's talk about how to launch without giving up control → [daniel@cumbuca.com](mailto:daniel@cumbuca.com)
* **Know someone scaling in Brazilian payments?** Introduce us!
* **Investor focused on LATAM fintech infra?** We'd love to connect.

---

## 🔗 Learn More

* Website: [cumbuca.com](http://cumbuca.com)
* Product Hunt: We're live — your upvote helps! 🚀

---

We spent 7 years getting here. Now we're just getting started.

Dale. 🇧🇷

— Daniel, Bruno, Pedro & the Cumbuca team

name: Floatpays Inc
all_locations: Cape Town, WC, South Africa; Remote
long_description:
Floatpays is an on-demand wage access platform that helps employees access, spend, save and manage their money.

The problem we are solving is that more than 75% of the 12 million employed South African’s run out of money before the end of the month, 52% of those end up borrowing money to survive. Informal lending is the only option for most borrowers, with interest rates anywhere between 30-50%. The story is the same in most African countries where payday/micro-lending has become the norm amongst lower-income earners.

Our app features include financial education, a budget planning tool, cash access, and voucher purchases all from wages earned but unpaid. We are currently working on a savings product to promote long-term financial resilience.
	
We launched our product in South Africa in July 2020 and plan to extend our reach into additional African countries in 2022 and beyond.
one_liner: On-demand wage access service built for the African market

launches.title: The Hudson Labs Co-Analyst - AI for equity research
launches.tagline: Meet the Co-Analyst - the precision of a terminal with the adaptability of AI
launches.body:
Hey everyone [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

We’re [Kris](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kbennatti/) and [Suhas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/piesauce/) – co-founders of [Hudson Labs](https://www.hudson-labs.com/).

**TL;DR**

The Hudson Labs Co-Analyst is high-precision AI built for institutional investors. We achieve state-of-the-art results in financial workflows, outperforming big labs.

Ask: Can you introduce us to hedge funds, asset managers or family offices with a U.S. public equities focus? We’ll say thanks with you a free 2 month subscription. No quants please.

Contact us at [kris@hudson-labs.com](mailto:kris@hudson-labs.com)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dpIkzPxCWk4

**❌ The Problem**

**Generalist artificial Intelligence fails most dramatically in finance-specific use cases**:

* Multi-document analysis
* Guidance identification
* Numeric accuracy and precision

As a result, AI solutions have **failed to deliver the consistency, reliability and usability required by institutional investors**.

Traditional financial service software providers, like Bloomberg or FactSet, provide coverage of standardized data e.g. net income. But less structured information e.g. soft guidance or product-level results, can often only be found manually. As a result, many of the most sophisticated investors in the world, have **painfully manual workflows**.

AI solves this problem but only when it meets the industry’s standards of consistency, reliability and relevance.

[**👷**](https://emojipedia.org/construction-worker) Our Solution

**The precision of a terminal with the adaptability of AI**

* Any metric. Any format.
* Only the facts. Direct-from-source. Every time.
* No prompting gymnastics. Just ask and get results.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93710&key=user_uploads/481926/211d2d5e-17da-466e-8b29-f811276153ff)

**Get up to speed in 2 hours instead of 2 weeks**

* **Management commentary linked directly to the numbers.** Track trends side-by-side with management quotes on drivers, exceptions and hedges.
* **Soft guidance captured — every word, every hedge.** No missed forward-looking statements, no guesswork.
* **All documents, one clear answer.** Filings, releases, decks, transcripts — synthesized so you don’t miss a line.
* **Verbatim summaries — no spin, no paraphrase.** The most important management statements, word-for-word.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93710&key=user_uploads/481926/a6b20947-aa46-4aa3-8ab9-838878e6d468)

**Where generalist models fail, the Co-Analyst gets it right — fast, precise, and source-verified.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93710&key=user_uploads/481926/d3eb854f-4232-4061-8ee8-cde37086a1c5)

Read about how we compare to Perplexity Pro [here](https://www.hudson-labs.com/post/hudson-labs-co-analyst-vs-perplexity-ai) and to OpenAI wrappers [here](https://www.hudson-labs.com/post/hudson-labs-co-analyst-vs-gpt-4o).

Try it out yourself at https://www.hudson-labs.com/#book-a-demo

[**👬**](https://emojipedia.org/men-holding-hands) The Team

We are a small, highly technical team and we’ve been working on finance-specific LLMs and AI systems since 2019. Our team **launched the first ever financial services app entirely powered by LLMs in 2021 (Bedrock AI)**.

[**Suhas**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/piesauce/)**:** Author of the popular textbook, [Designing Large Language Model Applications published by O'Reilly Media](https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/designing-large-language/9781098150495/). He has been the chair of the Toronto Machine Learning Summit for the last five years and has been invited to speak at 22 AI conferences this year!

He was one of the co-chairs at Big Science for the BLOOM LLM, which was the world’s largest open-source multilingual LLM at the time of release and has made contributions to various other LLMs and their training datasets.

[**Kris**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kbennatti/): Former CPA turned data scientist. 10+ years in capital markets. Previously roles include corporate governance data science at Hansell McLaughlin, Python instruction at AI Deep Dive and assurance at KPMG.

**🙏 Our Ask**

Ask: Can you introduce us to:

* hedge funds, asset managers or family offices with a U.S. public equities team (long-only, l/s, short-only)
* corporate intelligence or strategy teams (focused on public companies)
* public directors & officers (D&O) insurance teams in the U.S.

Make an intro to a relevant team, and we’ll thank you with a free 2-month subscription.

Contact us at [kris@hudson-labs.com](mailto:kris@hudson-labs.com)

Talking to 5.000 gamers we learned that 46% have been scammed more than once. Over half are minors, who are stuck trading for cash on social media due to their age. 

We are the first to build a fully compliant system for parental consent, enabling the majority of gamers to trade legally and giving the parents peace of mind.

There are 215 million trades annually in games we support. We make 7 dollars on average per trade. So a $1.5B initial market, growing fast alongside gaming and blockchain game economies.   

The team behind previously co-founded the largest transactional marketplace for secondhand high end clothes in Denmark, with 1 million users and a yearly transacted GMV north of $40 million.

name: Rebill
long_description:
Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.

Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.
one_liner: Financial infrastructure for the Americas

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Rebill started from a clear problem: companies wanted to sell in Latin America, but payments were too fragmented to scale efficiently. Approval rates were weak, local methods were missing, subscriptions were hard to manage, and every country required a different setup.

We began by solving that pain directly, helping merchants collect more effectively across the region. As we went deeper, it became obvious that the real gap was not just billing software, but infrastructure. Companies needed a single platform that could abstract away local complexity and let them operate across markets with speed.

That is how Rebill evolved from solving recurring payments into building payments infrastructure.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer:
We applied to YC because we were building in a category with a much bigger opportunity than people usually assumed. We did not want to build a regional tool. We wanted to build infrastructure with global relevance.

YC helped us sharpen the story, move faster, and think much more clearly about category, ambition, and execution. It pushed us to simplify the message and focus on what truly mattered.

The batch and Demo Day helped us position Rebill as a company solving a fundamental infrastructure problem, starting with LATAM and expanding beyond it.

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer:
We stay active in the YC community through Bookface, founder relationships, and ongoing use of YC resources across fundraising, hiring, product, and tactical problem solving.

What continues to matter most is access to founders who are building with intensity and clarity. YC remains part of our operating environment, not just part of our history.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
Rebill started by addressing recurring billing and payment problems for companies operating in Latin America. Early on, we focused on helping merchants navigate subscriptions, collections, and the operational complexity of the region.

The first major inflection point was realizing that software alone was not enough. The deeper problem was payment infrastructure itself: local rails, local methods, acquiring, recovery, and settlement.

The second major inflection point came when we moved closer to the rails and began building direct infrastructure instead of depending only on third parties. That changed the economics, product depth, and strategic value of the business.

Today, Rebill is building a broader payments infrastructure layer for LATAM and the US, with the long-term goal of becoming the financial infrastructure for underserved markets.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
The core problem is that companies expanding across LATAM and similar markets face fragmented payment infrastructure.

They need local methods, better conversion, subscription support, transparent settlement, and a fast path to launch, but the market is still dominated by patchwork solutions, slow enterprise processes, and country-by-country complexity.

This is a big problem because payment performance directly affects growth. Poor infrastructure means lower approval rates, less access to local demand, slower launches, and lost revenue.

We decided to work on it because we saw firsthand how large the gap was and how few companies were actually productizing a solution that developers and operators could use quickly.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
Our long-term vision is to build the financial infrastructure layer for underserved markets.

We are starting with payments in LATAM and the US because that is where companies feel the pain most immediately: collecting money, scaling across markets, and doing it without operational chaos. Over time, we want to make entering complex markets as simple as launching in the most developed ones.

If we succeed, companies will no longer need to assemble fragmented providers, local entities, and manual workflows just to operate internationally. They will integrate once and scale across markets through infrastructure that makes difficult geographies feel simple.

### **🧠 The Problem**

Institutional Investors know they need to adopt AI — but where does one start?

* AI is new, noisy, and fragmented.
* Consultants lack the required knowledge and are expensive.
* Broadly available mainstream AI tools aren't built with investor workflows, compliance, or security in mind.

Meanwhile, fintech AI startups are building targeted specialised agents — but distribution to investment funds is a huge challenge.

### **💡 Our Solution**

**Vantedge AI** is the first Agent marketplace with distribution to a rapidly expanding client base of 10+ blue-chip institutional investors managing **$100B+ in AUM**.

* **For investors:** A secure, plug-and-play platform with curated AI agents to streamline research, diligence, and analysis.
* **For AI startups:** A distribution and infrastructure layer that gets your agents in front of institutional clients, with SOC 2-level compliance, usage tracking, and real-world data access.

We’re now opening up access to our Agent Marketplace for startups building fintech AI tools.

### **⚙️ How It Works**

* Investors can upload any document or search for filings and instantly run a vetted AI agent — like an SEC filings parser or investment memo generator.
* AI startups can integrate their agents through our SDK and securely run them inside investor workflows — no sales motion required.
* All data is stored in a secure Data Vault with workspace-level access, so funds can collaborate and startups can serve verticalized use cases.

launches.title: Yardstick - Data-driven startup valuation and KPI benchmarking tool
launches.tagline: Benchmark and value startups with ease
launches.body:
Hello, YC community! We're Ravi and Vijay, data enthusiasts and startup founders who've faced the significant challenge of quantifying startup success. Through our experiences in building and growing companies, we've recognized a glaring need in the market for transparent, accessible benchmarking and valuation metrics—tools that rely on data rather than just intuition or incomplete data. Here is a [quick demo](https://app.storylane.io/share/916eqxtsotpo). 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80487&key=user_uploads/763615/96e63adc-0b0b-46db-a6cc-0ddca5afeb65)

**What Yardstick Offers:**

Yardstick delivers comprehensive tools for accurately benchmarking startup performance and estimating valuations. _Our platform utilizes an extensive dataset of startup performance metrics, providing growth rate percentiles to precisely position startups against a broad database. Moreover, Yardstick computes valuation estimates_ through sophisticated models that analyze KPIs in relation to valuation data and qualitative insights from hundreds of startups.

**The Problem and Our Journey:**

Navigating the vibrant startup ecosystem, we found that evaluating these ventures has traditionally been more art than science_. Our experience in assessing hundreds of early-stage startups for equity and debt investments revealed the difficulty of understanding their market standing without resorting to costly market research or external consultants_. This challenge inspired the creation of Yardstick.

**Our Solution:**

Yardstick seamlessly integrates into the workflows of fintechs, investors, and entrepreneurs wanting to underwrite a startup’s performance. Our solution offers not just KPI benchmarking but also insights into current valuations. _With both an API and a user-friendly web application_, Yardstick serves both technical and non-technical users, ensuring comprehensive accessibility.

**Give it a try:**

We are thrilled to introduce Yardstick and are eager for your feedback. Whether you are a fintech looking to perform KPI benchmarking on potential clients, an investor in need of data-driven tools, or a startup founder trying to understand where your startup stacks up against peers or what should be the latest valuation based on current traction, [we invite you to try out Yardstick](https://ventureinsights.ai/yardstick/) (without a need to sign up!) and share your insights. For those interested in integrating our tools directly, check out our [API documentation](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/32615745/2sA35G3MMX).

We look forward to your feedback!

Thank you,

Ravi and Vijay

Early-stage investing is fraught with scattered data, cumbersome discovery, and a lack of effective tools for analyzing startups with minimal track records. Post-investment, investors grapple with the pain of tracking scattered investment updates, often losing out on pivotal insights.

### **The Solution**

Enter VentureInsights, your AI-driven hub for early-stage investing. Here's how we're changing the game:

launches.title: 8vdX - Extend your seed extension with a ‘seedex booster’ of up to $1M
launches.tagline: Venture debt marketplace with a fundraising stack for early stage startups
launches.body:
**We are excited to announce the launch of 8vdX Seedex Booster, a new addition to our expanding product portfolio at 8vdX. This product offers early stage startups the opportunity to access seed extension debt of up to $1 million.**

Until recently, we were focused on providing bridge to Demo Day loans to current YC batches. However, the current market environment has given us the opportunity to expand our product offering.  The 8vdX Seedex Booster aims to solve some of the fundraising challenges currently being faced by founders including;

* Not enough funding runway to meet the performance benchmark expectations of series A investors
* Decreased valuations that require founders to achieve significantly higher targets in order to avoid a down round 
* Raising seed extension rounds can be challenging in the current environment

8vdX's Seedex Booster program augments a startup’s seed extension raise with up to $1 million of additional funding with founder friendly venture debt.

**How it works is pretty simple:**

**8vdX is offering to contribute up to 25% of a startup's seed extension round**, with the remaining 75% sourced from insiders or others. Our ticket size is between $250k-$1 Mn, capped at 25% of your seed-ex round. Here is an example of how it would work:

* Let’s say you are a startup which has just launched a **$1 Mn seed-ex round** and applied for the 8vdX seedex booster. After evaluating your startup, 8vdX gives a commitment of $250k representing 25% of the total seed-ex round. 
* **We will disburse the $250k** along with the $750k equity investment from other investors. _If you raise $750k in multiple tranches, we can make pro-rata disbursements_.
* Maturity of up to 18 months or Series A closing, whichever is earlier

_Assuming, the following terms have been negotiated and agreed upon by both parties:_

* Interest cost: 
  * cash interest of 1% per month ($2.5k) that you pay each month and
  * bonus SAFE of 5% i.e. ($125k) with the same valuation cap as the seed extension investors. 

_8vdX allows for flexibility in selecting a combination of cash interest and bonus SAFE._

* Repayment schedule: The seedex booster will be repaid with the Series A funding. However, founders have the option to create an amortization schedule to prepay the loan or extend it upon maturity.

Overall terms are founder-friendly terms as there is **no prepayment penalty, no collateral, no personal guarantees & no enforcement action.**

**Please apply at** [**8vdx.com**](http://8vdx.com) **or email us at** [**zeronote@8vdx.com**](mailto:zeronote@8vdx.com)

**Our aim is to help you achieve your maximum potential and successfully raise Series A funds.** How do we know this approach works? We have firsthand experience using it to drive growth and secure successful fundraises for startups. In fact, our own business model was developed through observing startups leverage our capital to accelerate their growth and secure successful fundraises.

We are thrilled to have already partnered with over 20 YC startups and look forward to supporting you as well. Join us in driving this innovative approach to fundraising!

**Interested startups, please visit our digital** [**platform**](https://8vdx.com/) **to learn more and apply.** The entire process is simple, transparent, fast, and completely digitized. If you have any questions, please feel free to email us and we will be more than happy to set up a call.

Thanks,

Team 8vdX

launches.title: Drivingforce - Rippling for trucking
launches.tagline: All-in-one workforce management solution for the trucking industry
launches.body:
### **TLDR**

Drivingforce is building “Rippling for trucking”, an all-in-one workforce management solution for the trucking industry. We consolidate multiple back office functions such as compliance, payroll, and recruiting, so trucking fleets can manage their entire workforce in one place.

### **WHY is Rippling (or Gusto, ADP) insufficient for trucking?** 

Compliance is uniquely challenging for trucking fleets because:

1. The majority of their workforce consists of truck drivers who are regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT).
2. Due to the nature of the labor market, there is a high volume of truck driver turnover within fleets, resulting in a considerable amount of administrative overhead.
3. In addition to personnel, they also need to manage a number of expensive assets, such as trucks, trailers, etc.

Generic HR solutions (e.g. Rippling, Gusto, ADP, etc.) are insufficient for trucking fleets because they are not designed to address these distinctive needs. Consequently, fleets resort to adopting various point solutions alongside their HR providers, resulting in increased operational complexity of managing multiple systems.

### **Solution**

Drivingforce is an all-in-one workforce management solution designed for trucking fleets. It consolidates multiple point solutions into a single platform, simplifying compliance, fleet management, and HR operation. Key modules include:

* **Compliance:** Automated monitoring and alerts ensure DOT and regulatory compliance.
* **HR:** Streamlined onboarding and tracking of essential employee data and documents.
* **Asset Management:** Efficiently track assets, assignments, and maintenance schedules.
* **Hiring:** DOT-compliant digital application portal and applicant tracking system (ATS) optimized for driver recruiting.
* **Payroll:** Seamless payroll processing, accommodating various pay structures like hours, miles, or load.

With Drivingforce, trucking fleets can effectively manage their back office all within a single platform.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72422&key=user_uploads/425869/797d4bd4-c4af-456f-9cbe-629c7a608668)

### **Backstory**

My path to Drivingforce was not linear, and I had no prior experience in trucking. Previously, I worked on another supply chain idea related to manufacturing, but decided to pivot. While exploring other supply chain sectors, I became intrigued by the trucking industry due to its immense size and potential opportunities.

As I got started, I reached out to several other trucking founders in the YC community for guidance. Interestingly, a few of them independently shared a similar piece of advice: _"If you want to learn about trucking, go to truck stops and talk to truckers.”_

Taking their advice to heart, I embarked on a series of visits to truck stops. Along the way, I decided to document my experiences and learnings through [**TikTok, under the name “Trucking Newbie”**](https://tiktok.com/@truckingnewbie). Some of these videos gained traction within the trucking community. As the TikTok account grew, content creation became a unique way for me to engage with users and conduct market research.

During my exploration, I consistently heard trucking company owners express their challenges in managing a dynamic workforce. As I delved deeper, I observed how they pieced together various tools and processes to manage their personnel and equipment while trying to comply with DOT regulations. Witnessing their frustrations with juggling multiple systems in their daily operations, the idea for Drivingforce took shape.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72422&key=user_uploads/425869/fe60374d-d25c-4e12-8e19-69727d333451)

### **Asks**

* **📣 Share:** Share this post with your network.
* **🔔 Follow:** Follow us on [TikTok](http://tiktok.com/@truckingnewbie) and [LinkedIn.](https://www.linkedin.com/company/drivingforcehq/)
* **🤝 Refer:** If you know of any trucking fleets that could benefit from Drivingforce, please connect us ([kevin@drivingforce.co](mailto:kevin@drivingforce.co)).

Hi everyone, we are Madhu and Baran, from [Flagright](https://flagright.com).

# 🚀 Introducing Flagright AI Forensics: The modern standard in AML compliance

At Flagright, we've created a powerhouse tool that enhances the speed and quality of financial crime investigations. By blending natural language processing with robust AI agents, we transform how fintechs and banks stay compliant and prevent financial crime.

# 🔍 The Problem

Financial crime investigations take too long. Fintechs & banks cannot scale volume and grow without hiring a proportional amount of headcount into AML and fraud departments. This is because data is silo’d, teams have to access data on many different tools, and process/manipulate this data to investigate the suspicious activity as they reach a conclusion. As a result, they are always limited by the time it takes to conduct these tasks every single day for every single alert.

# ✨ The Solution

AI Forensics delivers extreme performance through natural language queries and AI-native analysis of suspicious activity. It can learn from a company’s internal policies, procedures, or continuous usage of the platform such as how past investigations were conducted.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76102&key=user_uploads/672295/67c58686-2cad-4bf5-83dd-29cef4e17321)

It is build on top Flagright’s centralized data infrastructure and data processing pipelines with LLMs and algorithms. That’s how it’s able to deliver accurate, cohesive analysis across a wide variety of use cases. Unlike pure LLM solutions, it can accurately make factual analysis, calculations, and display charts & tables instantly.

# 🛠 How It Works

Flagright provides an all-in-one software for financial institutions to manage financial crime risk and meet AML compliance regulations 🕵🏼. Our unified API delivers the essential (and mandatory) capabilities for regulatory compliance such as transaction monitoring, risk scoring, sanctions screening, case management and more, all managed via a no-code, flexible, and intuitive interface by the operational teams.. Flagright offers the fastest integration times globally: 4 days on average across all integrations with fintechs in 6 continents.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71272&key=user_uploads/89898/43eea7a5-9a88-4233-b405-f0a70bc36ebe)

> # 
>
> # **The launch: Flagright AI 🤖**
>
> Financial crime ops teams spend a lot of time doing research on customers and investigating suspicious activity on a daily basis. The mundane tasks are the main driver of inefficiency and headcount for financial institutions and fincrime teams 😩. Flagright AI **automates these tasks and even eliminates it entirely** for certain use cases such as merchant monitoring 🔎.

In addition to our proprietary technology, Flagright AI leverages the GPT API for specific features. **This is the first time the power of GPT is brought to AML compliance teams at scale, globally!** 🚀

Here's an overview of the newest capabilities:

1. **Merchant monitoring and alerting 🔎:** The GPT-powered merchant monitoring and alerting module enables Flagright customers to monitor merchants across multiple sources and channels with zero manual input. It eliminates 100% of manual monitoring efforts and improves fincrime operations while ensuring fast response times and maximum risk-mitigation.
2. **Salesforce, Zendesk, and Hubspot integrations + GPT summaries ✉️:** The CRM integrations will consolidate your CRM correspondence within the Flagright case management system, with Flagright AI summarizing the highlights of customer correspondence. It eliminates the need to comb through tens of emails and messages for each customer correspondence. As a result, it saves analysts 15% of their time each day, improving operational efficiency and accuracy.
3. **Case and alert narrative generator ✍️:** Our AI Narrative Writer drastically improves analyst performance, decreasing the time it takes to write a contextual narrative for each suspicious activity by 90+%. Flagright AI captures an analyst’s writing style, sentiment, user information, case closing reason, and specific suspicious activity.
4. **AML AI risk score ⚠️:** AML Compliance Officers can now leverage AI to risk score their customers as a complementary mechanism to their traditional risk assessment (CRA) approach. The combination of heuristics & AI delivers maximum operational efficiency while maintaining explainability for regulators.
5. **SAR generator 📇:** Our Suspicious Activity Report generator leverages GPT and can automatically create a SAR for any suspicious activity flagged by our platform's monitoring systems, reducing the time spent by 99%. Flagright AI ensures that SARs are generated consistently and accurately and reduces the risk of errors in manual SAR creation.

Flagright AI represents a significant milestone in our journey to empower financial institutions with best-in-class operational tooling for AML compliance and fraud prevention.

We are excited to see the impact that Flagright AI will have on our customers and building a safer, more secure financial ecosystem. [Contact us](https://www.flagright.com/contact) to schedule a free demo if you are interested in learning more.

launches.tagline: Now available in LatAm and SEA 🚀
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82277&key=user_uploads/556140/a5ad7448-63b6-42a8-934d-3a149c352ec1)

When we started Grey in 2020, we just wanted to make it easy for people like us to receive payments for work without any stress. Over the last four years, we’ve enabled global banking access to digital nomads across the US, UK, Europe, Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, and Nigeria.

Today, I’m excited to announce that Grey is now available to remote workers, digital nomads, and creatives in **Brazil** 🇧🇷, **Ghana** 🇬🇭, **Indonesia** 🇮🇩, **Mexico** 🇲🇽, the **Philippines** 🇵🇭, and **South Africa** 🇿🇦! Get started at [grey.co](http://grey.co).

In the next few weeks, we’ll roll out to more Latin America (LATAM) and Southeast Asia (SEA) countries. If you’re a digital nomad, freelancer, or remote worker in these countries, you can enjoy the following:

* Get a free USD, EUR, or GBP account to receive your salary and payments.
* Convert to other currencies (MXN, BRL, PHP, IDR, ZAR, NGN, KES, TZS, GHS, etc) and send to your local bank account or mobile money wallet.
* Get a virtual card to spend.
* Send Stablecoins (USDC) to your external wallet addresses.

We’re on a mission to make globalisation work for everyone by providing inclusive banking solutions regardless of location, and this expansion takes us six steps closer today.

If you know any communities we should speak to or any person in these markets we should connect to, please let us know at [founders@grey.co](mailto:founders@grey.co).

Cheers

launches.title: Arpari – Multibank treasury management
launches.tagline: One login for multibank finance teams
launches.body:
# [**👋**](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand) Hi YC,

I’m Alex, founder of [Arpari](https://www.arpari.com/). Over the past 3 years, we’ve been working with commercial real estate finance teams to streamline their bank account data. We’ve built a multibank dashboard to provide a single login to teams working with hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks. 

💸 Today we’ve launched **multibank payments**, further reducing the need for teams to log into separate bank portals. Now, teams can fully manage their account inventory, reconcile transactions, and make transfers in a single dashboard.  

🚀 Recently, we have **expanded our focus beyond** real estate to satisfy all entity structures. Whether you are a small finance team with a simple account structure or you deal with hundreds of subsidiaries and entities and the complexity that brings, Arpari makes it easy to streamline your bank-related processes. 

# **TL;DR**

* Arpari centralizes account inventory, balances, and transactions across all your accounts, making month-end processes a breeze
* Our dashboard works with any number of banks and complex entity structures 
* Today, we launched payments so your team just needs to log into a single portal to set up and approve all payments to vendors, investors and anyone else
* Do you know any finance teams that work with more than one bank? Please introduce us! Email [Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com](mailto:Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com) or [book a demo here](https://www.arpari.com/book-demo)

  

# **❌ The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/57361321-c472-4677-955d-e6feecc21f04)

Finance teams who are responsible for balance reporting and transaction reconciliation often scramble at month end, don’t report at the frequency they’d like, or sacrifice reporting accuracy altogether.   

1. **ACCOUNT INVENTORY**: Using multiple banks can mean liquidity is an unknown, especially for teams who work with many accounts. Bank accounts tracked in Excel—many unnamed or vaguely labeled—makes effective management nearly impossible. Often accounts are missed, and cash misplaced. 
2. **MANAGING ACCESS**: Financial operations are severely hindered by fragmented bank access scattered across multiple team members. Accountants regularly need separate logins, deal with constant lockouts, and navigate multiple security code requests, reducing productivity. Add in payment approval workflows, and you have duplicate, complex permissions to manage across multiple portals. 
3. **DATA NORMALIZATION**: Beyond data access, when teams finally gather transaction data across banks, the data comes through in various formats. Many banks only offer PDF downloads, some banks don’t even provide export.  
4. **TRANSFER MONITORING**: Teams need to log into multiple portals to monitor pending transactions and approvals. Additionally, when vendor or investor bank details change, they need to update the information across multiple portals.

 

Teams who have tried to solve this problem have found treasury software that doesn’t work for multibank users. Incumbent solutions price with bank-by-bank implementation, which doesn’t work for users who have hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks, with their account and bank list constantly in flux. 

  

# 👩‍💻  **Our Solution: One login for all finance teams needs**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/7bf3d96a-04c3-4687-b9a6-6d369a929170)

  

We’ve built a dashboard for finance teams to interact in one place. When teams are doing the same manual tasks 10+ times, why not do them once? 

### STABLE CONNECTIONS

We leverage various connection methods to banks to provide stable, usable data daily to our customers. The account, balance, and activity information is the foundation to all workflows for our customers; unifying this information into a single place gives them back time for month-end reporting, peace of mind, and full transparency of their true cash flow.  

### DASHBOARD CUSTOMIZATION

We offer added customization to help organize account, balance, and activity data. Our dashboard is built around teams with complex fund and entity structures and prioritizes easy navigation according to how our users think about their bank information. 

### SINGLE PORTAL ACCESS

With payment approval workflows and read-only access, finance teams no longer need to permission non-account signers into bank portals. Finance teams can conduct their day-to-day operations without needing to log into 10+ portals to make payments or pull activity. 

  

Whether you are the controller sending investor distributions and paying vendors, an executive who wants a headline snapshot of cash, or an accountant reconciling transactions, Arpari saves you time. 

  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/a04f6c1b-0560-4b46-88f3-006cef73f664)

# **🙏  Ask**

* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/arpari/), and [book a demo](https://www.arpari.com/book-demo) with our team. 
* **Share this post!** -  Do you know anyone in your network who is a CFO, controller, account manager, or treasurer? Please share this post! 
* Learn more at [arpari.com](http://arpari.com)

 

👉 Contact me at [Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com](mailto:Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com)

### **TL;DR:**

Banking app for 62M Latinos in the US by a team out of Scotiabank’s Digital Factory & 3 consumer-focused Unicorns

### **Problem**

Latinos are all looking for a banking product that speaks to our needs and worries

### **Solution**

**We’re building a new banking experience that starts by solving key pain-points:**

* Opening a **US-Bank account online** (linked to a Visa Debit Card) with just a passport instead of having to visit a bank branch with a painful paperwork when lacking an SSN
* A friendly banking app with **Group Chats** we can join to lend or borrow money from each other **globally** instead of relying on Alternative Financial Services or cash
* **Sending remittances in minutes with zero fees** vs paying on ave. 6% ($18 for the ave. $300 monthly remittance)

### **Team**

We’ve previously built Digital Banking products for millions of customers in LatAm and have personally lived through the struggles of migrating to the USA.\
\
Now, we’re on a mission to remove financial barriers for Latinos in the USA and we’re doing it with a social approach because we all know that not everyone might need a bank, but everyone needs a Pana _(Spanish for pal)._

* [Try out Pana](https://www.joinpana.com/) & help us spread the word ([IG](https://instagram.com/pana.app?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y=)/[FB](https://www.facebook.com/panaapp)/[in](https://www.linkedin.com/company/panaapp/)/[Twitter](https://twitter.com/joinpana))
